steps.label: capture root container pre-destroy
steps.expect: zero exit; reference capture for the offline diff of everything below

steps.label: destroy attempt while fsl-dpaa2-ptp is bound
steps.expect: unknown outcome and that is the probe (dprtc.md unknown 3, bound half): the creator is the MC itself and the kernel holds the object. restool prints 'is destroyed' unconditionally on its error branch, so trust ONLY the read-back on the next step, never this output

steps.label: read back: did the bound destroy take effect?
steps.expect: zero exit. If dprtc.0 is still listed, the bound destroy was refused or ineffective — that is the finding; continue to the unbind. If it is gone, skip (s) the unbind and unbound-destroy steps below

steps.label: unbind fsl_dpaa2_ptp from dprtc.0
steps.expect: zero exit; releases the kernel's hold. The sysfs directory carries the driver's registered name fsl_dpaa2_ptp — underscores, not the hyphenated module spelling (rev-1 finding: the hyphenated path does not exist). Skip (s) if dprtc.0 was already destroyed by the bound attempt

steps.label: kernel PTP death evidence
steps.expect: the driver symlink must be gone; record whether the /dev/ptpN chardev disappears with the unbind — the one-way-trip-for-PTP claim made observable

steps.label: destroy the unbound DPL-born dprtc.0
steps.expect: the real answer to dprtc.md unknown 3: whether GPP software may destroy the MC-created singleton at all. Judge by the read-back, not the unconditional 'is destroyed' print

steps.label: capture root container post-destroy
steps.expect: zero exit; capture for the offline diff — the only expected delta vs the pre-destroy capture is dprtc.0's absence

steps.label: reboot for the restore check
steps.instruction: Reboot the board now. This is the first test of the recovery guarantee's restore direction (V-RECOVERY-1 proved a reboot erases additions; this proves it re-creates a deleted DPL-born resident) and it also clears any dpdbg set residue (console/log/level) left by V-DPDBG-1. After boot, run the driver again with V-DPRTC-3/postboot.probes.json
steps.expect: operator reboots after acking; the transcript for this run ends here
